summary: Intermittent 503 "overloaded" on /v1/chat/completions during peak (us-east) — customer seeing new overload behavior
content:
Issue summary
Banyan Search reports intermittent 503 responses with message "overloaded" from /v1/chat/completions during peak traffic windows in us-east. Customer notes this behavior is new in the last ~48 hours and is replacing what used to present as long tail latency / timeouts.

Customer impact
- End-user searches intermittently fail during traffic spikes.
- Customer is unsure whether to retry and at what cadence; concerned about retry storms and user-visible error rate.
- Reported error rate peaks at ~1.5–3% for 10–20 min bursts; normal baseline <0.2%.

Customer report (from Banyan Search)
- Time window: 2025-11-21 16:40–17:15 UTC and 2025-11-22 17:05–17:30 UTC
- Region: us-east
- Endpoint: POST /v1/chat/completions (stream=false)
- Model: redwood/llama-3.1-70b-instruct
- Typical prompt length: ~2k–6k tokens, max_tokens=512
- Observed: HTTP 503 with JSON error body; some responses include Retry-After, others do not (see samples)

Example error payloads (customer-provided)
1) 503 response
- Date: 2025-11-21T16:52:11Z
- x-request-id: req_9b8d4b7b9a4e
- x-correlation-id: corr_01HD9ZP3N6Y8Q4Y2W4
- Status: 503
- Body (redacted):
  {"error":{"message":"The service is temporarily overloaded. Please retry.","type":"overloaded","code":"overload_shed","param":null},"request_id":"req_9b8d4b7b9a4e"}
- Headers: (missing Retry-After)

2) 503 response
- Date: 2025-11-22T17:12:04Z
- x-request-id: req_2a13d0c41c7f
- x-correlation-id: corr_01HDA1F9QG2JX1H6K9
- Status: 503
- Headers: Retry-After: 2
- Body (redacted):
  {"error":{"message":"The service is temporarily overloaded. Please retry.","type":"overloaded","code":"overload_breaker_open","param":null},"request_id":"req_2a13d0c41c7f"}

Internal initial triage (Support)
- Confirmed we have ongoing canary/progressive enablement of overload protection in us-east for a subset of tenants.
- Correlation IDs map to breaker events around the same time window.
- Linked to #incidents thread: sources/slack/incidents/1743527710.json (us-east burst)

Environment / signals (SRE notes)
- us-east decode queue depth elevated; token/sec saturation near cap on the 70B pool.
- Breaker open rate spiked for chat-completions route on 70B; shed rate increased but p99 latency improved vs prior burst behavior.
- No evidence of downstream dependency brownout (auth/billing healthy); primary factor appears to be capacity saturation.

Investigation notes
2025-11-21
- Christine Wong (Eng) + Rafael Mendes (SRE) checked dashboards:
  - Breaker transitions: frequent OPEN/CLOSE flapping at ~30–90s intervals
  - Shed reason split: ~65% runtime_queue_saturation, ~25% gateway_concurrency_cap, ~10% regional_capacity_signal
- Hypothesis: thresholds too tight for this tenant’s burst pattern + long prompts; also missing Retry-After on one of the gateway code paths.

2025-11-22
- Verified some overload responses missing Retry-After due to mixed fleet (older gateway pods) + route-specific handler that wasn’t applying default header.
- Customer’s requests are non-streaming; they are sending bursts of 40–80 rps with high prompt token variance.
- Smart Routing fallback was NOT enabled for this tenant (no configured fallback model/region).

Actions taken
1) Customer guidance (same day)
- Support advised customer to:
  - Treat 503 overloaded as retryable.
  - Respect Retry-After if present; otherwise use exponential backoff with jitter starting at 500ms–1s, max backoff 10–15s.
  - Apply client-side request coalescing / queueing during bursts to avoid parallel retries.
  - Use idempotency keys on retried requests if they have side effects in their app.

2) Mitigation / tuning (SRE + Eng)
- Applied a tenant-specific policy adjustment in us-east:
  - Increased gateway concurrency cap by +20% for Banyan Search chat-completions route (bounded by tier default max).
  - Adjusted breaker open threshold to reduce flapping (slightly higher open threshold, longer cool-down).
  - Added a stricter shed policy for extremely large prompts to protect overall pool (hard cap consistent with plan).
- Confirmed no noisy-neighbor regression for other enterprise tenants in us-east after change.

3) Fix to ensure Retry-After consistency
- Flagged as bug: overload responses missing Retry-After in some cases.
- Engineering tracked to PR: github/redwood/pr-18472-load-shedding-retry-after-and-client-guidance
- Rollout plan: deploy gateway patch to us-east first, then global.

Customer communication
- 2025-11-21: Acknowledged issue; explained this is explicit overload protection behavior intended to fail fast (vs timeouts) and is safe to retry with backoff.
- 2025-11-22: Shared preliminary client retry recommendations + offered to help configure fallback model.
- 2025-11-25: Confirmed tuning changes applied and Retry-After fix rolling out; asked customer to monitor and share any remaining correlation IDs.

Resolution
- After threshold tuning (2025-11-23) and partial rollout of Retry-After fix (2025-11-25), customer-reported overloaded 503 rate dropped to ~0.3% during comparable peak window; no missing Retry-After observed in sampled responses post-deploy.
- Marking ticket Resolved; will reopen if errors return or if fallback routing is requested.

Follow-ups / next steps
- (Eng) Ensure Retry-After is set across all overload response paths (gateway + routing + downstream), including legacy route handlers. Linked issue: SUP-2860.
- (CSM/Support) Offer Banyan Search a configuration review for:
  - Fallback model (70B -> 8B) during overload (quality tradeoff) and/or regional fallback (us-east -> us-west) if acceptable. Linked issue: SUP-2892 for similar fallback behavior checks.
- (SRE) Continue monitoring us-east breaker flapping metrics and adjust cool-down defaults before expanding canary.

Comments (timeline)
- 2025-11-21 09:18 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Created ticket from customer email; requesting Eng/SRE review. Provided first correlation IDs.
- 2025-11-21 10:02 PT — Rafael Mendes (SRE): Confirmed overload protection canary active in us-east; correlates with incident INC-2025-11-21-us-east-burst-timeouts. Will review thresholds.
- 2025-11-21 11:20 PT — Christine Wong (Eng): Noted missing Retry-After on some responses; likely mixed gateway fleet + handler gap. Looping in gateway owner.
- 2025-11-22 08:45 PT — Christine Wong (Eng): Tenant-specific policy tweak proposed to reduce breaker flapping; Rafael to apply once verified safe.
- 2025-11-23 13:10 PT — Rafael Mendes (SRE): Policy change applied for Banyan Search in us-east. Watching shed rate + p99 latency. No broader regression seen.
- 2025-11-25 15:30 PT — Owen Phillips (Support): Customer confirms improvement; asked for written retry guidance to share with app team. Pointed to Support doc and provided snippet.

Customer-facing guidance snippet (sent)
“If you receive a 503 overloaded response, the request did not run to completion. You may retry. If the Retry-After header is present, wait at least that many seconds before retrying. Otherwise, use exponential backoff with jitter and avoid sending parallel retries that can amplify load.”
